I am very disappointed with the Dadar branch of Aakash. The faculty change is very unpredictable. Teachers keep changing frequently, which affects continuity in studies. Many times junior faculty members are assigned, and the overall teaching quality feels compromised.

It also seems like the institute does not pay teachers well, because many good teachers leave quickly. Due to this, students suffer.

Another major issue is syllabus completion. They rush the syllabus at the end instead of covering it properly throughout the year. This creates unnecessary pressure on students.

Overall, my experience was not good and I do not recommend this branch.

featured_reviews.name: Shiv
featured_reviews.review_text:
Highly Recommended for IIT-JEE & NEET Aspirants

Aakash Institute, Dadar Branch, is one of the best choices for serious aspirants preparing for NEET & IIT-JEE. As a parent/student, here are the points that really stand out and can help others make an informed decision:

1. Expert Faculty – Teachers are highly qualified and explain concepts in depth with real exam focus. Regular doubt-clearing ensures no student is left behind.

2. Structured Study Material – Well-researched modules, NCERT coverage + competitive level problems make preparation effective for both boards and entrance exams.

3. Regular Tests & Feedback – Weekly/fortnightly tests simulate the real exam environment and detailed analysis helps students track improvement.

4. Personalized Guidance – Mentors and faculty provide one-on-one attention, guiding students based on their strengths and weaknesses.

5. Strong Track Record – The Dadar branch has produced excellent results in both NEET and JEE, with many students qualifying top colleges.

6. Scholarship Opportunities – Through ANTHE/iACST exams, deserving students can get significant fee waivers, making quality coaching affordable.

7. Supportive Environment – The management and counseling team are approachable, keeping parents updated about performance, progress, and attendance.

8. Focus on Discipline & Consistency – Regular classes, timely syllabus completion, and revision programs help students stay exam-ready.

9. Strategic Preparation – Emphasis on time management, exam temperament, and smart techniques for problem solving.

10. Holistic Approach – Not just coaching, but complete mentoring for competitive exams, boards, and future academic planning.

✅ Overall, Aakash Dadar offers the right blend of experienced faculty, systematic study plan, test series, and personal mentoring. For parents looking for a reliable institute and students aiming for top medical/engineering colleges, this is a great choice.

featured_reviews.review_text:
As an RMO2 batch student, I noticed another batch is already ahead of us terms of syllabus and tests. When I asked a non-teaching staff member for a printout of one of their test papers, I was denied, though a few other students from my batch received it! Is this really because a massive institute like Aakash couldn't spare an A4 sheet! Students pay fees in lakhs, and a paper costing a few rupees would barely register on the balance sheet I guess?
It's frustrating and unfair that access to essential study material is selective, leaving genuine students without the resources they need. One would hope such a thing isn't repeated.
